verdict.rationale: Microsoft Authenticator is documented only as a mobile app with in-app password autofill (via an 'Autofill' settings section) and passkey sign-in inside the app itself — there is no mention of a browser extension anywhere in the evidence pack. Community evidence further confirms the app's password-autofill feature is actually being discontinued entirely, reinforcing that no browser-extension-based TOTP/passkey autofill capability exists.
